openQuestions: How prices were obtained: Trip.com detail pages never render room rates. All prices are snapshots; recheck on booking day. No USD conversion is used any more.

The price-band filter (15~Range) changes which room is shown, so a room's rate can differ slightly by band (for example, Tavern's shared-bath double at CNY 102 or 116). Only the cheapest matching room per band was visible; other room types were not all priced.
